I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot because my perennial crops grow well enough with the cow manure and compost I collect from my animals, and fertilizer is too expensive for a small plot like this. I will use our own traditional cuttings and seeds that my family has saved, not the improved ones from the cooperative, because these plants have always done well for us. My family will tend to this plot throughout the season, but since it is only a quarter hectare we can manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone from outside.
